caption: The drawing depicts a single ceramic jar with a rounded body and a slightly narrower opening at the top. The jar is predominantly light brown with areas of darker brown and gray shading, giving it a weathered appearance. The rim of the jar is decorated with a repetitive pattern of vertical lines, and just below the rim, there are a few horizontal incised rings encircling the jar. Around the upper middle of the jar, the text “WARNE & LETTS:1807” is inscribed in uppercase letters. Below the inscription, the jar features several sets of overlapping, scalloped shapes outlined in a darker color, arranged in a repeating, scale-like pattern. The background of the drawing is plain and beige, with no additional objects present.
title: Crock
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
